title: Grade 7 Science — Thu, Jun 04
description: Nutrition in Animals — Day 4 of 5: Feeding in simple animals and applications
subject: science

questions.question: In amoeba, the process by which it surrounds and engulfs food is called:
questions.explanation: Amoeba engulfs food by surrounding it with pseudopodia, a process called phagocytosis.

questions.question: Digestion in amoeba takes place inside the:
questions.explanation: Amoeba digests food inside a food vacuole using digestive juices.

questions.question: After digestion in amoeba, the simple food is absorbed and waste is removed by:
questions.explanation: Amoeba absorbs digested food and removes undigested waste through its cell surface.

questions.question: Hydra digests its food in a hollow space called the:
questions.explanation: Hydra digests food in its central body cavity after pulling prey in with tentacles.

questions.question: A mosquito feeds on blood using mouthparts shaped for:
questions.explanation: A mosquito has piercing and sucking mouthparts to feed on blood.

questions.question: Why is it important to brush our teeth regularly?
options: To remove food bits and prevent tooth decay
questions.explanation: Brushing removes food and bacteria that can cause tooth decay and gum disease.

questions.question: Tooth decay is mainly caused by bacteria acting on ____ left on teeth.
questions.explanation: Bacteria break down sugar on teeth and produce acids that cause decay.

questions.question: A housefly feeds by first releasing saliva on solid food to:
options: Turn it into a liquid it can suck up
questions.explanation: A housefly pours saliva on food to dissolve it, then sucks up the liquid.

questions.question: Which feeding method matches the animal correctly?
options: Butterfly – sucking nectar through a proboscis
questions.explanation: A butterfly sucks nectar using its long proboscis.

questions.question: Why should we drink enough water and eat fibre-rich food?
options: To help smooth digestion and prevent constipation
questions.explanation: Water and fibre help food move smoothly through the digestive system and prevent constipation.

questions.question: A leech feeds on blood, so it is an example of a:
questions.explanation: A leech sucks blood from other animals, making it a blood-sucking parasite.

questions.question: When a person suffers from severe diarrhoea, the body loses a lot of:
questions.explanation: Diarrhoea causes the body to lose water and salts, which must be replaced.

questions.question: A simple, safe drink given during diarrhoea to replace lost water and salts is:
questions.explanation: ORS (a solution of water, salt and sugar) helps replace water and salts lost during diarrhoea.

questions.question: How is digestion in amoeba similar to digestion in humans?
options: Both break complex food into simpler substances
questions.explanation: In both, complex food is broken into simpler forms the body can use, even though the structures differ.

questions.question: Which habit is BEST for a healthy digestive system?
options: Chewing food well and eating fibre and water
questions.explanation: Chewing well and eating fibre with enough water keeps digestion healthy.
